title: Pre-Analysis — Lower Cover Stringer Run-Out Reinforcement Between Ribs 8 and 14

ata.title: Wing Box Structure — Lower Cover Panels

abstract: Original pre-analysis for the local build-up of the wing lower cover at the stringer run-outs inboard of rib 14 on the stretched four-engine aircraft, closed with three conditions attached to the repair population.

sections.objective: Establish what the proposed local build-up of the lower cover at the stringer run-outs would conflict with on the stretched four-engine aircraft, given that the affected panel region is already covered by an approved blend-out and bonded strap repair and that a substantial part of the fleet has been through at least one ultrasonic survey. The work order also had to confirm that tank entry and the trailing edge harness routing impose no constraint that the design office had not allowed for.
sections.findings_summary: Three conditions came out of the search and one was close to blocking. The approved blend-out and bonded strap repair sits on exactly the run-out region the build-up covers; an aircraft carrying a bonded strap has neither the thickness nor the surface condition the new fastener pattern assumes, and the repair population inboard of rib 14 is not small. The parts figure holds the run-out region as a single panel assembly with no provision for a build-up variant, so an alternate row and its own effectivity are needed before any embodiment. The trailing edge harness that runs through the same rib bays is bracketed to the lower cover at two positions inside the reinforced area, and the wiring office had not been consulted. Nothing was found that changes the fatigue argument itself.
sections.next_steps: Obtain a written position from the repair design office on whether a bonded strap can be over-worked by the build-up or must be removed first, and size the affected population before the design review. Raise an illustrated parts change request for the build-up variant with its own effectivity. Bring the wiring office into the design review so the two bracket positions are resolved on the drawing rather than on the aircraft. Confirm the ultrasonic survey interval remains valid on the reinforced panel.

evidence.similarity_note: Top result on both methods: the same panel and stringer part set, and near-identical description of the run-out region.

expected_findings.rationale: The approved repair blends out the run-out and restores load path with a bonded strap. The build-up assumes parent thickness and a clean faying surface at the same fasteners. The two cannot occupy the same run-out, and the repair population inboard of rib 14 is significant.
expected_findings.resolution: Obtain a repair design position on over-working versus removal, and size the affected population before design review.

expected_findings.rationale: The figure treats the run-out region as one panel assembly with no alternate for a reinforced standard. Without a variant row and its own effectivity there is no way to order the build-up items or to tell the two standards apart in service.
expected_findings.resolution: Raise an illustrated parts change request for the build-up variant with its own effectivity.

expected_findings.rationale: The trailing edge harness is bracketed to the lower cover at two positions inside the reinforced area. The build-up changes the local thickness and the fastener pattern at both, and the wiring office was not in the original scope of the design.
expected_findings.resolution: Bring the wiring office into the design review and resolve the bracket positions on the drawing.

evidence.similarity_note: Reached from the repair scheme to the inspection task that calls it up.

expected_findings.rationale: The ultrasonic inspection is written for the parent panel thickness. A reinforced run-out changes the back wall echo and the technique has to say which standard it is inspecting.
expected_findings.resolution: Raise a maintenance change request for a standard-dependent technique note once the design is frozen.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares every panel and stringer identifier and the same rib bays, and is returned first by entity linking. It is the ultrasonic survey that establishes the finding population for this work and is a companion to the reinforcement rather than a conflict with it.

type_data.conclusion: The reinforcement is sound. Three conditions attach: a repair design position on the bonded strap population, a parts figure variant, and resolution of two harness bracket positions.
